title: Where the 2023-24 UAP reports came from

source.name: Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena
source.publisher: All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO), U.S. Department of Defense

notes: Of the 757 new UAP reports in AARO's May 2023-June 2024 review period, 392 came from the Federal Aviation Administration -- which accounts for all FAA-sourced UAP reports since 2021. The remaining 365 came from military and other government sources.
